gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Wiry and distinctive, Gugi stacks tall lowercase nearly to cap height with open-cut terminals, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri sits beneath it, short in the ascenders. Gugi grabs the eye; the body just carries the words.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-syriac-western: Gugi leads with bold, tall lowercase and no thick-thin flicker. Noto Sans Syriac Western follows, its terminals held far from the stroke, so bump its size up a touch for comfort.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Distinctive from the first glance. Gugi's rounded-wire strokes carry the attitude, while Noto Sans Tagalog keeps its middle zone dominant and its curves generously gapped, a sturdy counterweight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa fills most of its height with open curves and clear gaps, quietly steady. And Gugi, with its tube-like constant-width stroke, supplies the bold display voice above it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads approachably, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch. Over a longer passage it would feel gentle, with barely any step from capitals to lowercase, set beneath Gugi's engraver-cut heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Gugi sets bold letters with no thick-thin variation, tall lowercase pressing toward the capital line. Noto Sans Tai Tham echoes that chalk-board crowding with c interiors left visible.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Bold, wiry and unmistakable, Gugi holds one stroke thickness throughout, while Noto Sans Tai Viet, a plain sans, keeps short ascenders and a tall x-height. Its strongest quality is that tidy handoff.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-takri: Gugi cuts its letters like laser-cut sheet, one stroke width everywhere, with tall lowercase. Noto Sans Takri meets that with generously unclosed small curves, and the strongest quality is how clearly they differ.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil reads as if magnified, its terminals stopping far from the stem, yet the size never changes. And across a longer stretch it stays open and easy, while Gugi's pen-like constant line sits above.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplemen: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement reads stocky, its round forms like open parentheses. Over a longer passage that tall middle band feels dense and sturdy, with Gugi's unswelling round bowls leading above.
